issues.title: IndexOutOfBoundsException in MobTooltip.onTooltip when hovering empty output slots (mobs with few/no loot entries
issues.body:
### Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 1.21.1 |
| NeoForge | 21.1.252 |
| Just Enough Resources | **1.6.0.17** (NeoForge 1.21.1) |
| JEI | 19.51.0.418 |
| Java | 25.0.1 (Microsoft OpenJDK) |
| JER config | `itemsPerRow = 4`, `itemsPerColumn = 4` (defaults) |

### Crash

```
Description: Rendering screen

java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 10 out of bounds for length 0
	at java.base/java.util.ArrayList.get(ArrayList.java:428) ~[?:?]
	at TRANSFORMER/jeresources@1.6.0.17/jeresources.jei.mob.MobTooltip.onTooltip(MobTooltip.java:22)
	at TRANSFORMER/jei@19.51.0.418/mezz.jei.api.gui.ingredient.IRecipeSlotTooltipCallback.onRichTooltip(IRecipeSlotTooltipCallback.java:43)
	at TRANSFORMER/jei@19.51.0.418/mezz.jei.library.gui.recipes.layout.builder.LegacyTooltipCallbackAdapter.onRichTooltip(LegacyTooltipCallbackAdapter.java:17)
	at TRANSFORMER/jei@19.51.0.418/mezz.jei.library.gui.ingredients.RecipeSlot.addTooltip(RecipeSlot.java:164)
	at TRANSFORMER/jei@19.51.0.418/mezz.jei.library.gui.ingredients.RecipeSlot.drawTooltip(RecipeSlot.java:396)
	at TRANSFORMER/jei@19.51.0.418/mezz.jei.library.gui.recipes.RecipeLayout.drawOverlays(RecipeLayout.java:282)
	at TRANSFORMER/jei@19.51.0.418/mezz.jei.gui.recipes.RecipesGui.lambda$render$2(RecipesGui.java:378)
	...
Screen name: mezz.jei.gui.recipes.RecipesGui
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Install any mod that registers a mob whose loot table is **missing or empty**
   (in my pack: the `amberith` mod registers 7 mobs and ships only one
   `data/amberith/loot_table/entities/*.json`; the other 6 resolve to `LootTable.EMPTY`).
2. In JEI, search for that mob's spawn egg (e.g. `amberith:block_cow_spawn_egg`).
3. Press **R** (or **U**) to open the JER mob page.
4. Move the mouse cursor over the 4×4 output grid.
5. → client crash.

No special timing is needed: with **zero** drops every slot is a landmine, so the very
first hover crashes. (In the attached log the cursor happened to land on slot index 10.)

### Root cause

The three points below were confirmed by disassembling the shipped jars. The Java snippets
are reconstructed from the bytecode and are semantically equivalent to the source, not verbatim.

#### (a) JER attaches a tooltip callback to *every* grid slot, including the empty ones

`jeresources/jei/mob/MobCategory.java` — `setRecipe(...)`:

```java
List<LootDrop> drops = entry.getDrops();
int max = Math.min(drops.size(), Settings.ITEMS_PER_ROW * Settings.ITEMS_PER_COLUMN);

for (int i = 0; i < Settings.ITEMS_PER_ROW; i++) {
    for (int j = 0; j < Settings.ITEMS_PER_COLUMN; j++) {
        int idx = i + j * Settings.ITEMS_PER_ROW;          // 0 .. ROW*COL-1

        IRecipeSlotBuilder slot = builder
            .addSlot(RecipeIngredientRole.OUTPUT, 97 + x, 43 + y)
            .setSlotName(String.valueOf(idx))
            .addTooltipCallback(new MobTooltip(entry));    // <-- registered for ALL slots

        if (idx < max) {                                   // <-- only this respects the bound
            slot.addItemStacks(drops.get(idx).getDrops());
        }
        ...
    }
}
```

With the default config that is **16 slots (0..15)**, and all 16 carry a `MobTooltip`.

#### (b) JEI invokes tooltip callbacks even for empty slots

`mezz/jei/library/gui/recipes/RecipeLayout.java` — `getSlotUnderMouse(...)`, second loop:

```java
for (IRecipeSlotDrawable slot : this.recipeCategorySlots) {
    if (slot.isMouseOver(x, y)) {      // pure rectangle hit-test — no isEmpty() filtering
        return Optional.of(new RecipeSlotUnderMouse(slot, area.getScreenPosition()));
    }
}
```

`RecipeSlot.isMouseOver(x, y)` is only `this.rect.contains(x, y)`.

Then `mezz/jei/library/gui/ingredients/RecipeSlot.java` — `addTooltip(...)`:

```java
private void addTooltip(ITooltipBuilder tooltip) {
    this.getDisplayedIngredient().ifPresent(...);              // ingredient tooltip IS guarded
    for (IRecipeSlotRichTooltipCallback cb : this.tooltipCallbacks) {
        cb.onRichTooltip(this, tooltip);                       // callbacks are NOT guarded
    }
}
```

`RecipeSlot.isEmpty()` exists but is not consulted on this path.

#### (c) `MobTooltip` uses the slot name as a list index with no bounds check

`jeresources/jei/mob/MobTooltip.java`:

```java
public void onTooltip(IRecipeSlotView recipeSlotView, List<Component> tooltip) {
    LootDrop lootDrop = this.entry.getDrops()                                   // line 22
        .get(Integer.parseInt(recipeSlotView.getSlotName().orElse("0")));
    tooltip.add(lootDrop.toStringTextComponent());
    ...
}
```

`setSlotName` is fed `"0".."15"` by `MobCategory`, so the callback happily asks for
`drops.get(10)` even when `drops` is empty.

That is exactly the reported exception: `Index 10 out of bounds for length 0` —
10 is one of the 16 slot indices, 0 is the size of the drop list.

### Impact

This is **not** limited to loot-less mobs. The landmine condition is simply:

> `slotIndex >= entry.getDrops().size()` — every slot past the mob's drop count is broken.

| mob | drop entries | broken slots out of 16 |
|---|---|---|
| mob without a loot table (my case) | 0 | **16 / 16** |
| vanilla zombie | ~4–6 | ~10–12 |

It normally stays hidden because players hover the slots that visibly contain an item,
so only mobs with an empty drop list make it fire on the first hover.

### Suggested fix

Minimal, in `MobTooltip.onTooltip`:

```java
List<LootDrop> drops = this.entry.getDrops();
int idx = Integer.parseInt(recipeSlotView.getSlotName().orElse("0"));
if (idx < 0 || idx >= drops.size()) {
    return;
}
LootDrop lootDrop = drops.get(idx);
```

Equally acceptable in `MobCategory.setRecipe`: only call `addTooltipCallback(...)` when
`idx < max`, or do not create slots beyond `drops.size()` in the first place.

### Note: `WorldGenCategory` already does this correctly

For reference, `jeresources/jei/worldgen/WorldGenCategory.setRecipe(...)` completely avoids the
problem by only creating drop slots that actually have an entry:

```java
builder.addSlot(RecipeIngredientRole.OUTPUT, 6, 22)
    .addItemStacks(entry.getBlocks())
    .setSlotName("oreSlot")                       // a fixed string, not a numeric index
    .addTooltipCallback(tooltip);                 // only one slot carries the callback

for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(8, entry.getDrops().size()); i++) {   // bounded by the real drop count
    builder.addSlot(RecipeIngredientRole.OUTPUT, 6, 67 + i * 18)
           ...;                                   // no empty slots are ever created
}
```

And `WorldGenTooltip` only passes the slot name through as a plain string (it never parses it
into a list index). `DungeonTooltip` is safe for the same reason.

Applying the same shape in `MobCategory` — loop bound `drops.size()` instead of
`ITEMS_PER_ROW * ITEMS_PER_COLUMN`, with `addTooltipCallback(...)` moved inside that loop —
would fix the crash and also stop the empty grid cells from carrying any callback.

### Workaround (for users hitting this)

`config/jeresources-common.toml`:

```toml
hiddenTabs = ["mob"]
```

Caveat: the value must be the **path part only** (`"mob"`), because `JEIConfig.hideCategories`
builds the id via `ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("jeresources", category)` —
passing `"jeresources:mob"` would be an invalid path.

---
Powered by AI,but I hope this may help

issues.title: Forge 1.20.2+ support, when will it stop?
issues.body:
Hello there.

I am reaching out to encourage you as well as any other developer in the space to reconsider supporting the Forge mod loader for Minecraft version 1.20.2 and beyond.

As you are likely well aware, NeoForge was established by former Forge team members and has positioned itself as the technical and ethical successor. Yet, despite NeoForge's clear advantages, Forge remains relevant **only because developers continue to support it!** While I appreciate that you already support NeoForge, continuing to provide Forge builds undermines the transition and slows down the community’s progress.

The reality of the matter is that players do not dictate mod loader adoption. **Developers do!** Judging by publicly available statistics, many players are unaware of conflicts within the Modded Minecraft community and they will not stop using the Forge mod loader **until developers stop providing builds.** If no developer were to offer Forge support for Minecraft version 1.20.2 and above, players would naturally transition to its successor, NeoForge.

By maintaining Forge support, you are actively prolonging its relevance and thus far preventing a full shift to NeoForge. The best way to phase it out is simple:
- **Stop providing updates for Forge 1.20.2+**
- (If committed enough) **Remove existing Forge 1.20.2+ builds** 

The best time to drop Forge support was when NeoForge emerged.
The second best time. **Is.** **Now!**

Please consider taking actions and follow the lead by example.
**Your actions matter for the entire community's future!**


~ John
(written with the assistance of GPT-4o, I am sorry but this wouldn't have been formulated so nicely otherwise)

_This is a copypasta in order to more efficiently bring across this message to developers. The intentions remain the same._

issues.title: Loot table related recipe categories are not populated when connecting to a dedicated server
issues.body:
I was also running into a similar issue as #524.

tl;dr:
From poking around in the code, I believe it's due to `LootTableFetcher` not being set with a ReloadableServerRegistry here: https://github.com/way2muchnoise/JustEnoughResources/blob/master/Common/src/main/java/jeresources/util/LootTableHelper.java#L162-L179

1. Loot table based recipe categories call `lootTableFetcher.getLootTable` during initiation. e.g. https://github.com/way2muchnoise/JustEnoughResources/blob/master/Common/src/main/java/jeresources/compatibility/minecraft/MinecraftCompat.java#L43
2. When JER is run in the client only, the reloadable registry is unavailable and gets skipped here: https://github.com/way2muchnoise/JustEnoughResources/blob/master/Common/src/main/java/jeresources/util/LootTableHelper.java#L162-L179
3. When reloadableServerRegistries in LootTableFetcher is null, an empty loot table is returned: https://github.com/way2muchnoise/JustEnoughResources/blob/master/Common/src/main/java/jeresources/util/LootTableFetcher.java#L19-L21

issues.title: JER Not Working/Showing in Server Only
issues.body:
**Is there an existing issue for this?**

Yes, it seems this is a widespread issue amongst plenty in the issues.

**Current Behavior and Findings**

Mob Loot and Ore Tabs in recipe lookup for JER are Non-existent when playing on my Dedicated ATM9-0.3.4 server. But when playing single-player, they show/work just fine. Same setup both times, the same instance, just completely different behaviors. At the same time, two other players playing on the same dedicated server **can** see the Mob Loot and Ore Tabs when looking up recipes for items. That's a completely weird behavior to me.

In singleplayer:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d30a26fb-8bad-4f59-ad44-6b23b38748b5)

In multiplayer:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/50bcecf4-4971-4ba3-bf07-23b5a0d2c5cc)

**Expected Behavior**

To be able to see the Mob Loot and Ore Tabs provided by JER when looking up recipes of items and how to find them on multiplayer servers.

**Local Environment**
- **Operating System:** Windows 10 (Client) / Proxmox (Server)
- **RAM:** 24gb allocated, 64gb total
- **Java Version:** 17
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1
- **Modpack:** ATM9-0.3.4
- **Other Mods Installed:** These are installed solely to get rid of the "Enable Connected Textures" when using an HD texture pack.
        Sinytra Connector-1.0.0-beta.46+1.20.1, 
        Continuity-3.0.0-beta.5+1.20.1, 
        Forgified Fabric API-0.92.2+1.11.8+1.20.1
- **Shaders:** BSL Original_v8.3
- **Resource Pack:** Patrix_1.20_128x: Addon, Basic, Items, and Mobs all added

**Solutions and Remedies Tried**

1. I've tried the fixes outlined in other postings:
- disableLootManagerReloading = true in JEResources.toml (both client and server)
- disableLootManagerReloading = true in jeresources-common.toml (both client and server)
- mixin.perf.resourcepacks=false in modernfix-mixins.properties (both client and server)
- cacheResources = false in forge-resource-caching.toml (both client and server)

2. Delete configs on both client and server to have them recreated. Nothing changed
3. I've tried a different user profile thinking maybe it's my user data associated with the server. Logged in with an alt account that has never been on the server before, same results and behavior.
4. Pulled new downloads of the same updated version of JER for both server and client
5. I've completely deleted the instance, re-downloaded it, created a fresh install, and logged into the server. Nothing. Im at my wits end here.
6. I've even tried a completely different launcher. Curseforge, Multi-MC port, you name it. **WAIT**
- Upon trying CurseForge, compared to my choice for all my packs MultiMC (where I port it over from CurseForge), the tabs show up! So whatever MultiMC is doing to the pack when loading, it's messing something up. I do frequently see a Quark error "Quark (quark) has failed to load correctly java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 492 out of bounds for length 0" but have passed it off as nothing and usually would just reload the pack and wouldn't see it again. [Here](https://mclo.gs/H7svTvS) is the latest log for boot to try and trace down what is happening here.

All and all, it seems my choice of launcher and porting the pack over to it was doing something unknown and can't really crackdown as to what. But, now you might have an idea into what might be wrong with other people's issues with JER not showing up as there seems to be plenty without explanation. It could quite possibly be the Launcher they are using.

**UPDATE 12/4/24:** After logging into the server the next day, I found the Tabs missing from the server once again. Now I am truly confused as to what is going on. They were working last night, now they are gone. On the CurseForge launcher. Nothing has changed from the instance last night to this morning. So now I'm back to square one and will be re-opening this now.

issues.title: JER keep causing client crash on a fabric server.
issues.body:
I have fabric server version 1.20.2 and everytime i connect with it with JER installed in client i always get stuck at "Joining world" menu and my client start to not responed anymore but if i remove the JER in my mod folder, i can join normal without a problem.
i have JEI installed in server side as well the world-gen.json file config for the world both installed in server and client yet still causing not responding when joining.

issues.title: Not compatible with More Villagers mod
issues.body:
Hey, just want to say I love your mod and how it seems to list vanilla villager trades well and even almost every villager mod I come across. This includes Jewelry(RPG), Paladins & Priests, Beautify, etc. But for some reason there seems to be no compatibility with More Villagers (Fabric) by SameDifferent which is frustrating because there is a lot of villagers that come from that mod and its fairly popular. It seems like the code is meant to adapt to any mod but for this one it doesn't.

Do you have plans in the future to update your mod to be compatible with More Villagers. Or do you know a way in which I can easily modify the code client side to include the other villagers' trades by inputting them manually?

Thanks.

issues.title: Respect tag `c:hidden_from_recipe_viewers`
issues.body:
The tag `c:hidden_from_recipe_viewers` seems to be commonly used to indicate that an item should not be displayed in a recipe viewer like JEI, EMI, REI, etc. (I checked in the code for at least these three and they do.)

Currently, the categories added by this mod do not respect that tag.

**Expected behavior**
Any item with the `c:hidden_from_recipe_viewers` tag should not be displayed in any categorie/tab. 
This includes Enchantment, Dungeon Chests, Village Trades, etc.

issues.title: Crash when joining server
Ability to define trade data shown or update post reloading
issues.body:
Mostly a compat issue with Custom Village Trades Mod (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/custom-villager-trades-forge)

Essentially if you modify the trade tables with CVT, once the game loads and the new trades are established JER never relfects the changes trades even though the villagers themselves do. Is there some way to maybe load the trades later or let us generate our own jsons for trades similar to how we can provide our own worldgen data?

issues.title: Question / Suggestion: From where are the API methods supposed to be called?
issues.body:
I am wondering, from where one is supposed to call the methods in `IJERAPI` (on forge). I was thinking:

- `IJERPlugin#receive`: Doesn't work due to #452 and is also extremely limiting as it's impossible to react to loaded datapacks and similar things.
- `registerCategories` from a JEI plugin: Only works sometimes, depending on the plugin order. But even if it works, it will duplicate the entries when JEI reloads. The same is true for any other entry point from a JEI plugin.

So my suggestion is to add a callback into the `IJERPlugin` that is called on every JEI startup when `CommonProxy.initCompatibility()` runs. The API could then instantly commit into the actual registries and addon mods can react to datapacks. Also JER could then easily pass the `IJeiHelpers` to its plugins, which could potentially be useful for some plugins.

issues.title: FakeClientLevel is never constructed successfully
issues.body: JER adds a `FakeClientLevel` class that is used as a return value for `JERAPI#getLevel()`, when `Minecraft.getInstance().level` is null. However, the `FakeClientLevel` constructor calls `DimensionHelper.getType` which in turn calls `Minecraft.getInstance().level.registryAccess()` throwing a `NullPointerException` if `Minecraft.getInstance().level` is `null`. Therefore `FakeClientLevel`s can only be successfully constructed, if `Minecraft.getInstance().level` is not null, however in that case `JERAPI#getLevel()` just returns the existing client.

issues.title: Feature Request: Allow adding to vanilla mob drops
issues.body: If a mod adds drops to a vanilla entity (for example using a global loot modifier) and then tries to register these additional drops to JER, JER will create a separate page for that mob. It would be nice, if there was some way to show drops added by another mod together with the vanilla drops.

issues.title: Additional files missing on modrinth
issues.body:
While every CurseForge upload of JER includes two additionals files (`api` and `sources`), modrinth doesn't. However, these files are extremely useful when adding JER as a dependency. Also, from my experience, the modrinth maven works much better that the CurseForge one, and also has more readable dependency coordinates.

In order to use the modrinth maven for JER dependencies it would be very helpful, if the `api` and `sources` jars were uploaded to modrinth as well.

issues.title: EMI Compatibility Issue
issues.body:
JER works fine in normal JEI, REI Plugin Compatibility + REI, but it seems to not work on EMI+JEI. According to this issue https://github.com/emilyploszaj/emi/issues/196#issuecomment-1572578208, when EMI is loaded alongside JEI, JER crashes JEI's `mezz.jei.api.runtime.IJeiRuntime.getIngredientManager()` and prevents EMI from reading extra recipes from JEI.

This happens only when you load a save the first time, but if one exits to the main screen and re-load the save, error goes away, and other recipes load normally, though JER still fails to load.

issues.body:
Biomes for mob's spawn pages all default to them spawning everywhere, especially for custom mobs

issues.title: Villager Trades Show Incorrect Tiers
issues.body:
Villager trades seem to all show the 3rd tier slot and it would be a lot better if the item traded was put in the appropriate trading slot. 
![image](https://github.com/way2muchnoise/JustEnoughResources/assets/53978637/a0fcff86-b561-443c-8efd-72f47169a2a9)

For example, the trade here is a default trade at tier 1 according to the mod's repository, but the trade shows up at tier 3.

issues.title: Server issue
issues.body: The JER interface doesn't pops up on server side for any version of 1.19.2, for example, on single player, if you use the interface to analyze a "human heart" from vampirism mod, it tells you and shows you the Vampire hunter and its drops where there is a human heart on the drops, but if you do that on server, the interface doesn't exist, same for all mob drops, dungeon loot, its like JER is not there event though it works perfectly on single player, I doesn't know if you already knew about this issue that is why I'm reporting it, kind regards and thanks in advance.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Implement ExtensionPoint.DISPLAYTEST
issues.body:
Currently, the mod is required on both client and server or Forge will mark the connection as incompatible.

Forge allows registering an extension point to bypass this check, for mods that don't require both sides to be present. 

See the docs here for 1.16.x: https://mcforge.readthedocs.io/en/1.16.x/concepts/sides/#writing-one-sided-mods

and here for 1.18.x syntax: https://mcforge.readthedocs.io/en/1.18.x/concepts/sides/#writing-one-sided-mods

issues.title: Mod does not disable itself when ran on server side.
issues.body:
1.16.5

The mod was not disabling itself on server side causing issues where commands would not work. It disabled OP, and would not allow OPs to join the server when opped. I fixed it by removing the mod. But this can be an issue for other hosts.

Make it so your mod doesn't crash servers with errors that take an expert to debug. Please make your mod disable itself gracefully on the server like recommended in the forge documentation (https://mcforge.readthedocs.io/en/latest/concepts/sides/#writing-one-sided-mods)

issues.title: Update wiki to include enable cheats for profiling
issues.body:
I noticed that the /jer_profile doesn't work, unless cheats are enabled.

Perhaps it would be a good idea to update the wiki to include the following:

Note: Profiling is not yet implemented for 1.15+. Using an OTG world will not work with the profiling. Instead make a regulair world (the generated information will be the same either way).
**To start profiling, create a local world and enable cheats (don't need to be OP).** You can then use /jer_profile [chunk amount] [all] to create a world-gen-scan.json

This should help users to more easily find out why the command isn't found.

Edit: Also include that an OTG world will generate an error and make the server crash. (example of crash log in the comment below).

issues.title: Add a way to edit the block distributions manually
issues.body: While the profiler isn't working yet, could you maybe implement a way to edit the default values for ores etc. via config file/json? Would be greatly appreciated by people with custom ore gen that are well aware of their respective block distribution.

issues.title: JER parses loot tables before tags & other datapack elements are completed
issues.body:
Title.

JER parses loot tables a little early, which basically breaks the entire mod when any other mod uses tags or something similar in their loot tables (which happens fairly frequently).
Is there a reason the loot tables can't be parsed after datapacks are completed?

To be more specific - any loot table that uses a function or condition that relies on tags will cause TagRegistry to throw an ISE at line 131: "Tag {} used before it was bound"

issues.title: [enhancement] Render images of mobs in the sidebar of jei, like how some of the bees mods do.
issues.body: Mods like Productive Bees and Resourceful Bees have their bees isometrically rendered in the jei sidebar as if they were items. Being that it seems possible that you can pull entity models to show them in the mob drop menus, I couldnt see why they could also be rendered in the sidebar (likely unanimated. as the bees mods bees are animated and cause a considerable performance decrease when scrolling past them). Allowing players to search for mobs, and by extension their drops, spawn locations, rarities, etc. would be really cool.

issues.title: Add a method in MobEntry for replacing the drops list entirely
issues.body:
Currently MobEntry has a way to add drops to the drops list for a given mob, but it doesn't have a way to remove or clear drops.
Currently JER is overpopulating my mob's drop lists because it's parsing through additional tables linked from the first, which it shouldn't really do.
I'd like to override the drops MobEntry has by default with a new list, with some of the things removed

issues.title: Make LightLevel's constructor public
issues.body:
Can we make LightLevel's constructor public? The way it is at the moment, it only supports vanilla-esque lighting conditions for mobs, which not all mods use.
even just having access to a custom light level and relative would be enough to add more options. I don't see why this is locked off to the four existing options

If I get a chance I can PR this, but it seems like a simple enough fix without that

issues.title: Automatically generate block generation info from data packs
issues.body:
1.16+ only. Admittedly this may be a bit early to ask given that world gen customization is still an experimental thing, but if it's possible to somehow hook into both vanilla's default settings (especially if they become part of the vanilla client.jar/data/minecraft/ directory in future) as well as the settings of any active data packs, it should be possible to collect and display the relevant generation data rather than require that this mod specify it.

By doing this, #239 can probably be fixed - just group each thing by the configured feature it relies on. All ore veins would be grouped due to using minecraft:ore, all disks due to using minecraft:disk, all lakes due to using minecraft:lake if that's ever a feature, and so on. (A lot of configured features are pretty weirdly named and aren't obvious to most casual players though, so some grouping of sufficiently related configured feature types (for example, everything that uses minecraft:ore, minecraft:emerald_ore and minecraft:scattered_ore would all be classified under some main ore generation heading) as well as more intuitive naming would be required.

This should also allow resources from mods to be calculated and displayed in much the same way, assuming the mods in question define said features through data rather than hardcoding them (compatibility with this mod would be a good incentive to use data definition).

issues.title: [1.16.4-forge-35.1.13] Mod kills Vanilla ore generation in modpack (Crossmod bug, Idk how to add labels)
issues.body:
[Modpack](https://github.com/way2muchnoise/JustEnoughResources/files/5721555/Stages.of.Vanilla%2B.zip)

Almost all mods are included in this modpack with the exception of **JER**, because that seems to be the source of my issue, and **Botania**, so that I could upload the modpack zip folder (Botania is still part of the modpack).

The issue I'm currently having with this mod is that it kills all Vanilla ore generation when loaded alongside this modpack. I've tested this with the same world, using an x-ray texture. This is an issue because a number of items in the modpack require vanilla ores.

I've had this issue before with other mods, such as **Simple ores by skrallexy** conflicting with **Easy Steel by kwpugh**, and **YUNG'S Better Mineshafts by YUNGNICKYOUNG**.

issues.title: Leaked reference to client world object
issues.body: [This](https://github.com/way2muchnoise/JustEnoughResources/blob/c640e058c596eccca1c9aa86c4645ca8f814a75f/src/main/java/jeresources/compatibility/minecraft/MobCompat.java#L28) static field is assigned to the client world when the class is first loaded, but the reference is never updated. So it will be kept around when switching servers/rejoining, preventing the old world from being GCd.

issues.title: The fact that certain tabs automatically scroll instead of having several pages makes it nearly impossible to use
issues.body:
If, say, I want to see what all can be in a dungeon chest, I would see this page:
https://gfycat.com/honorablevioletbarasinga

This scrolls on its own, which means I can't get a clear list of what it has. Sure, I can hold shift to make it pause, but *why do I have to*? Why aren't there multiple pages of dungeon chest loot, literally every other recipe style? It's like if furnace recipes all cycled through whenever you wanted to look at one, and you couldn't choose which ones were visible.

The reason this is specifically annoying to me right now is that I want to find what spawns in dungeon chests that shoudn't, like IC2 ingots. Unfortunately, the only way to do that (without some kind of dumping mod) is to wait for it to refresh, hold shift, look for anything that shouldn't be there, bookmark it, then repeat.

This is true for basically all JER pages. There's a single page for Farmer trades, and it just randomly decides which trades to show instead of having multiple pages with all of them.

issues.title: [1.16] Smithing Table Recipes Are Not Shown
issues.body:
I'm going to be honest, I'm unsure if this is an issue with JEI, or with JER, as neither of these mods actually show smithing table recipes, despite the fact that some of these recipes **exist in vanilla**. If you try to view the recipe, of say, a netherite pickaxe, it only shows the anvil enchanting/repairing recipes, and not the diamond pickaxe+netherite ingot in a smithing table, recipe. 

This does not affect 1.16.2, as JEI added the smithing table recipes to 1.16.2, but hasn't done that to 1.16.1 yet.

issues.title: JER causing errors or crashes when viewing Mob Drops window containing mobs "ponified" by Mine Little Pony mod.
issues.body:
Does not have problems with non-ponified mobs.

With MineLP 1.12.2.3.2.4, ponified mobs simply don't display in the JER Mob Drops window, and the log file is spammed many times per second with `[Client thread/ERROR] [net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.RenderLivingBase]: Couldn't render entity java.lang.NullPointerException: null` multiple times per second. 

With MineLP 1.12.2.3.2.6 or 1.12.2.3.2.7, the game completely crashes when trying to view a Mob Drops window, with the error in the log starting with `Description: Rendering entity in world java.lang.NullPointerException: Rendering entity in world`.

Discussing it with a dev of that mod, they tell me that the issue is that your dummy world *should* be passing an empty chunk full of air, rather than passing a null chunk as it currently does.

The versions of their mod mentioned above can be found on [this releases page](https://github.com/MineLittlePony/MineLittlePony/releases).

issues.title: NPE from FakeClientWorld
issues.body:
[FakeClientWorld](https://github.com/way2muchnoise/JustEnoughResources/blob/1ca83769a2ee4d439b8fdda422b98677ebd6c929/src/main/java/jeresources/util/FakeClientWorld.java) does not initialize `World.mapStorage` field, leading to unexpected NPEs when other mods try to use the result of `World.getMapStorage`.

One solution would be to initialize `mapStorage` before [calling ForgeEventFactory.gatherCapabilities](https://github.com/way2muchnoise/JustEnoughResources/blob/1ca83769a2ee4d439b8fdda422b98677ebd6c929/src/main/java/jeresources/util/FakeClientWorld.java#L43v). Note that an access transformer is necessary as `World.mapStorage` is marked `protected`.

Related issues from StellarSky:

issues.title: Better support for bees
issues.body:
#177 fixes most issues with blocks with a wide range of blocks, but bees are special case. Each one contains random stats and a UUID, causing JER to treat each bee as a unique object.

Bees contain a massive, largely randomized NBT string. 90% of this can be ignored. This means that if you break 100 hives, you'll probably get 200 unique bees. This is too much information. The mod should only care about two things:

1. The item ID of the bee. This is used to tell if it's a princess or a drone.

2. The first part of the genome string: `Genome: {Chromosomes: [{UID1: "extrabees.species.water"`

This notes its species. This can also probably be obtained from the unlocalized string name.

The rest of the NBT can be safely discarded. While it is useful information for anyone interested in bees, there are much better ways to get this information.

issues.body:

```
[23:23:13] [Client thread/DEBUG] [jei]: Registering plugin: jeresources.jei.JEIConfig ...
[23:23:14] [Client thread/WARN] [jeresources]: Failed loading villager %s registered at %s

issues.title: Villager Trade Levels
issues.body:
It has come to my attention that this mod displays the Villager Trade Levels starting at "lv. 0", while in code they start, at least in Minecraft Forge, at `1`.

People who want to add trades using a mod, or via a CraftTweaker script, will have to do so using positive integers **higher than** 0. When they add a level 1 trade in-code, it will show as a level 0 trade in JER.
What I am talking about is the `net.minecraftforge.fml.common.registry.VillagerRegistry.VillagerCareer.addTrade` function as used [here](https://github.com/DevOnTheRocks/RockyCore/blob/master/src/main/java/rocks/devonthe/rockycore/crafttweaker/merchant/MerchantTrade.java#L47-L49).

Considering that showing the levels of trades is mostly cosmetic and the only people who will really pay attention to them will be mod developers or crafttweakeneers like me, and the displayed number in your mod doesn't match that in the code, I wondered if you could just...
Increase the displayed number by one. 😉

issues.title: DIY options for pack makers, via JSON or MineTweaker
issues.body:
Right now, pack-makers can manually create JSON files to represent ore distribution, which is awesome.

But for some heavily modded packs, the information given by JER can be either misleading or non-existent. For instance, let's say that using CustomNPCs, I have created a mob I call a "Blood Zombie", which drops a rare item defined using Content Tweaker called "Bloodstained Robe". Let's then say a player runs into a crafting recipe that requires a Bloodstained Robe. They click it in JEI... and get nothing.

Obviously, its completely unreasonable to expect your mod to identify this. But if you added craft-tweaker support, you could punt this responsibility back to the mod authors and make _them_ do it.

For instance:

```
mods.jer.JER.addMobEntry("Blood Zombie", <entity:customnpcs:customnpc>.withTag({Texture: "customnpcs:textures/entity/humanmale/woundedsteve.png"}))
mods.jer.JER.addMobDrop("Blood Zombie", <contenttweaker:bloodstainedrobes>, 0, 1, false);
```

Could display the given entity, with the given name, with the given drop.

This would make it far easier for pack makers to help players find new or modified items in intuitive ways. If a player, for instance, receives a quest to get a bloodstained robe, they often won't read the quest description; instead, they'll just go to JEI and look up the item in question. This sort of functionality would make it so a prepared modpack author can work _with_ that player expectation instead of _against_ it.

Similar features could be put in for all sorts of JER handlers. For instance, trade information can be manually entered so a pack author can help players find CustomNPC vendors that sell items in an adventure map. Authors can give JER data for their Recurrent Complex structures, so JER can display rare items that appear in pack-author-created locations. Meticulous pack authors can add crop data for mods like immersive engineering or natura.

This would be amazingly useful.

issues.title: License concern
issues.body:
This bit of the license is kind of concerning:
> ###Reserved Rights I reserve the right to change this license at any time, although chances are I won't, because legalese annoys me.

As this stands now, one interpretation could mean that if someone forks this code, following all of the terms, you could change the license to anything, including something prohibiting forking, and then demand that the previously-legal fork be removed, even if it hadn't incorporated any of your other changes since you changed the license. If this were the case, then nobody can really ever do anything without being at your mercy. Can you tweak this to make it clear that this isn't the right interpretation? Maybe adding a sentence like this:
> If I ever change this license, the old version will continue to apply to all revisions prior to the change; the new version will only apply to revisions after the change.

issues.body:
tested with both default san serif and also Kristen ITC >>> this is copped from https://github.com/cubex2/BetterFonts/issues/13 > I did a thorough source of cubex2/BetterFonts maybe there's a conflicting use of java.lang output code somewhere? I couldn't find any reason JEI should be reloading.

The only time I can get the crash is with

TTFR-1.11.2-1.7.3
jei_1.11.2-4.3.5.274
JustEnoughResources-1.11.2-0.6.3.5
On Forge 1.11.2-13.20.0.2296

I ran the just enough resources /profile 100 all command with only JEI and JER, it completed and output to files successfully. I then installed betterfonts and ran the command again, and the server hung, I had to kill the process. Removing betterfonts removes the conflict, so I assumed the issue was in betterfonts.

Either JER tries outputting in truetype or something weird (why would it use the minecraft font and not the system default?) or when the /profile command tries to complete betterfonts attempts to reload JEI for some reason and hangs the server.

Anyway I would appreciate if you could look into this a bit more? It's able to be worked around by simply disabling better fonts, running the command, than re-enabling. No big deal. :D

#workaround #minor

It is possible this isn't your code and it's the Just Enough Resources code. I haven't looked into anything further than the test described here. I don't mind cross posting this to JER if you deem it necessary.

Thanks!

issues.title: [1.10.2-0.5.9.3] Doesn't update to reflect tweaks to loot made using the vanilla loot tables system
issues.body:
As per the title, if you use the vanilla loot table system to tweak various loot sources, JER still displays the untweaked loot tables.
I am guessing this is a case of JER getting the loot info at instance launch, while the vanilla system uses files within the world save folder ("world/data/loot_tables").
However, since this is a vanilla tweaking system, I would suggest that it is something that _should_ be supported.

issues.title: Pokecube Compatiblty Issue
issues.body:
It seems the recent change has removed the ability to add in an array of LootDrop for a mob, and requires a resource location instead.  The way Pokecube handles loading in drops from configs, it is much easier to generate and array of LootDrop, than to try to make loot tables to add into the world thing.

Can you re-add a method for the IMobRegistry which takes a collection or array of LootDrop for a case like this?  If not, I can try to make a PR for this in the next few days, if I get the time to do so.

When rendering outside of the RecipeGui, mobs do not properly render.

The rendering is called here:

There is a glScale followed by a glTranslate, and then draw is called. I believe the issue to be with the scissoring, but I'm not sure where the bounds would be incorrect. I have tried rendering at several z-levels to rule that possibility out.

issues.title: Crash when rendering mob info without GUI open
issues.body:
Crash Report: http://pastebin.com/Wnsms90X
JEI Version: 2.22.4.106
JER Version: 0.2.1

The NPE comes from the assumption that there is a GUI open when determining the pitch and yaw of the mob when rendering.

https://github.com/way2muchnoise/JustEnoughResources/blob/master/src/main/java/jeresources/jei/mob/MobWrapper.java#L77

The render is done here:

https://github.com/superckl/RecipeTooltips/blob/master/src/main/java/me/superckl/recipetooltips/handler/RenderTickHandler.java#L107

A possible fix would be to have a default pitch and yaw when there is no GUI open (`mc.currentScreen == null`).

Example of when this crash would happen if it was the mob info:

http://i.imgur.com/R0SYN0P.png
